title: Third-party action referenced by a mutable tag in gha — review required
description: uses: with a branch or major-version tag runs whatever the upstream repository points at today. A tag can be moved or a compromised maintainer can retarget it, so the workflow executes code that was never reviewed. The rule flags mutable refs; pinning to a commit digest is the accepted practice.
remediation: Pin each third-party action to a full commit SHA and let a dependency bot propose digest updates.
limitation: Lexical: matches branch and major-version refs; digest pins and local actions are not reported.
